title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Credit Balance and Refund Amount on an Ended Plan
content:
**Definition.** The credit balance of an ended Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan is the fees collected plus the fee credits, less the fees charged and the refunds already paid on the plan, never below zero. All four amounts are totals of the plan's whole fee ledger.

**Refund amount.** The refund is the credit balance, rounded to the cent.

**Refund clock.** The refund's late days are the calendar days from the date the plan ended to the handling date, less 21, never below zero. The date the plan ended is the plan's termination date, or its cancellation date where it carries no termination date.

## Ledger reading

| Fee ledger entries on the plan | Effect on the credit balance |
| --- | --- |
| fee collections | add |
| fee credits (free-look refund credits and billing-error corrections) | add |
| fee charges | subtract |
| refunds already paid | subtract |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A cancelled plan's fee ledger shows charges of 120.00, collections of 120.00, one fee credit of 18.00 and no refund. The credit balance is 120.00 plus 18.00 less 120.00, which is 18.00, and the refund is 18.00.

A plan that ended on a hypothetical day 0 and is handled on day 30 has 9 late days (30 less 21); handled on day 15 it has none, since the count never goes below zero.

A plan whose ledger shows charges of 60.00 and collections of 45.00, with no credit or refund, has no credit balance: 45.00 less 60.00 is below zero, so the balance is taken as zero.
